ASCII.question: What is ASCII? Character encoding standard.
ASCII.fact: ASCII ( ASS-kee), an acronym for American Standard Code for Information Interchange, is a character encoding standard for representing a particular set of 95 (English-language–focused) printable and 33 control characters – a total of 128 code points.
